strings.records.connectwise-1400.title: ConnectWise: 14:00 UTC update reports continuing preparations, not the start of restoration
strings.records.connectwise-1400.body: Trust Center published an update for Monday October 26 14:00 UTC. It says preparations for phased partner onboarding continue and guidance will follow when restoration from existing backups can begin. This is not a report that restoration began on 10/26. Keep affected connections disabled until individual instructions arrive. Archives are encrypted, isolated, and preserved, with no indication of impact on other products. The next update is 10/27 14:00 UTC.
strings.records.connectwise-1400.action: Keep affected connections disabled. Do not reconnect until service-specific re-enablement instructions are issued. Continue separate M365 checks of Entra sign-ins, app registrations, consents, forwarding rules, and registered devices. Do not interpret infrastructure recovery or daily updates as permission to reconnect.
strings.records.gmo-seventh.title: GMO report 7: 12:00 is the attacker's announced time. Do not comply with demands
strings.records.gmo-seventh.body: The statement says a presumed attacker gave notice at 10/27 12:00 of information disclosure and a ransomware attack. Demands will not be met. Devices collected through 10/26 at 22 with cooperation in the investigation are being analyzed. This does not confirm malware installation. Account protection from report 6 is reiterated. Passwords or authentication codes will never be requested.
strings.records.gmo-seventh.action: If devices or accounts connected to the affected service, continue the checks in the 6th report from a separate safe device. Do not respond to unofficial demands for money or contacts offering to recover lost funds. Do not treat 12:00 as the official disclosure time. Not submitting a device does not mean it was unaffected.
strings.records.softbank-resume.title: SoftBank: disaster/evacuation information resumed at 23:17
strings.records.softbank-resume.body: Distribution of national and local government disaster/evacuation information resumed at 10/26 23:17, in addition to earthquake early warnings and tsunami warnings. SoftBank / Y!mobile / LINEMO say all emergency alert email information can be received. Maintenance lasted from 10/23 6:47 to 10/26 23:17. This is restoration of the carrier delivery path, not completion of fixes across the PHP ecosystem.
strings.records.softbank-resume.action: For affected lines, checking emergency alert settings is often sufficient. Carrier resumption does not mean your organization's PHP is patched or exploitation has ended.
strings.records.nvd-fortisandbox.title: FortiSandbox: authentication bypass via an alternative path (NVD Received)
strings.records.nvd-fortisandbox.body: CVE-2026-107656 describes authentication bypass through an alternate path and possible unauthorized code or command execution via crafted HTTP in FortiSandbox 5.0.0–5.0.6, 4.4.0–4.4.9, all 4.2 versions, and corresponding PaaS offerings. Status is Received. Do not infer fixed version numbers from NVD.
strings.records.nvd-fortisandbox.action: Only if the management plane is exposed to the internet, read FortiGuard FG-IR-26-185 and check official fixes by branch. Do not interpret Received as confirmed urgent exploitation.
strings.records.nvd-harbor-ssrf.title: Harbor: ProjectAdmin webhook SSRF
strings.records.nvd-harbor-ssrf.body: CVE-2026-111590 involves insufficient webhook destination validation. A ProjectAdmin can specify private or link-local destinations, with response bodies retained in execution logs. This is not unauthenticated compromise of all Harbor installations.
strings.records.nvd-harbor-ssrf.action: Check webhook creation privileges and destination restrictions, and verify the fix for GHSA-2phj-cp9f-qq6w.
strings.records.nvd-mongosh-emudhra.title: mongosh: eMudhra intermediate CA in bundled Node.js
strings.records.nvd-mongosh-emudhra.body: CVE-2026-115930 concerns mongosh before 2.14.0 including a recoverable eMudhra intermediate CA in its bundled Node.js TLS store. NVD says 2.14.0 bundles Node.js 24.22.1 or later. Installations via npm separately require updating the host Node. This does not prove a Tailworm fix.
strings.records.nvd-mongosh-emudhra.action: Check mongosh versions by distribution path separately from host Node versions. For eMudhra distrust, check the Node 24.22.1 series and mongosh 2.14.0 as instructed.
strings.records.nvd-mcp-toolbox.title: MCP Toolbox: unauthenticated file exfiltration and local overwrite
strings.records.nvd-mcp-toolbox.body: CVE-2026-93328 concerns path traversal and missing authorization in the cloud-storage source of googleapis/mcp-toolbox 1.2.0–1.4.0. NVD states that unauthenticated users can exfiltrate host files to external GCS and overwrite local files. Received.
strings.records.nvd-mcp-toolbox.action: Compare PR 3454 with distributor fixes only if exposing an affected version.
strings.records.nvd-avocent-wsserver.title: Avocent ACS8000: command construction in wsserver
strings.records.nvd-avocent-wsserver.body: runZero reports that CVE-2026-65184 involves root-privileged wsserver passing commands from WebSocket fields to system()/popen(). The public-key session path does not perform appliance session checks. Received. This investigation has not established a fixed version.
strings.records.nvd-avocent-wsserver.action: Only if managing the applicable appliance over the internet, cross-check runZero's advisory and vendor guidance.
strings.records.nvd-camel-saxon-oauth.title: Apache Camel: Saxon XXE and OAuth token caches.
strings.records.nvd-camel-saxon-oauth.body: CVE-2026-90885 is XXE in camel-saxon (4.0.0 to before 4.18.5, and 4.19.0 to before 4.22.2). CVE-2026-94386 is OAuth token cache confusion (4.19.0 to before 4.22.2). These conditions differ from the Docling path supplemented previously.
strings.records.nvd-camel-saxon-oauth.action: Match the components and series in use against official guidance for 4.18.5 / 4.22.2 or later. Do not count this as universal RCE across Camel.
strings.records.nvd-mautic7.title: Mautic 7: a series involving upload / SSTI / deserialization / SQLi and other issues
strings.records.nvd-mautic7.body: CVE-2026-115188–115196 have different conditions in Mautic 7: campaign import uploads, Twig SSTI, deserialization, SQLi in administrative AJAX and dashboard APIs, stored XSS, Asset API paths, Stats API permissions, and open redirects in public forms. Some require authenticated privileges or specific features. Do not add the 9 issues together as unauthenticated compromise of every server.
strings.records.nvd-mautic7.action: Only if the affected feature is used, check each GHSA's fixed versions and permission settings.
strings.records.nvd-bandit-http2.title: Bandit HTTP/2 and others: a separate cluster from HTTP2Shell (Brotli)
strings.records.nvd-bandit-http2.body: A series of resource exhaustion, complexity, compression amplification, and request smuggling issues in mtrudel bandit's HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1 implementations entered NVD. These are separate from the Brotli decoder flaw in CVE-2026-111497. Do not include systems in Brotli remediation solely because they use HTTP/2. Separate hackney CVEs are in the same batch.
strings.records.nvd-bandit-http2.action: Only where Elixir/Bandit or hackney is used on public interfaces, check each CVE's prerequisites and distributor fixes.
strings.records.ghsa-modified-19.title: GHSA: 0 newly published, 19 existing reviewed advisories revised
strings.records.ghsa-modified-19.body: The publication window contains 0 entries. The 19 updated entries include aiohttp 3.14.4, Keycloak, kobako, Grav, Wagtail, Talos Linux, Dolibarr, ImageSharp, PostCSS, retouched old Open WebUI GHSAs, and the Log4j 1-to-2 bridge. Updated means revisions to text or affected ranges, not a set of newly disclosed zero-days tonight.
strings.records.ghsa-modified-19.action: If installed, check current version boundaries in each GHSA. Do not add these again to previous publication counts.
strings.records.brotli-jfrog-reach.title: Brotli: reachability in .NET / FFmpeg / ClickHouse / Arrow is not an HTTP/2 flaw.
strings.records.brotli-jfrog-reach.body: CVE-2026-111497 is an out-of-bounds write in the C decoder. The aliases HTTP2Shell/Node2Shell/Brotli2Shell refer to the same CVE. .NET produces SIGSEGV; RCE is unproven. Fixed in 8.0.33/9.0.22/10.0.14; republish NativeAOT. FFmpeg→libjxl brob boxes corrupt pointers; a fixed release is unconfirmed. ClickHouse crashes with about 23MB of br data; the PR is merged but treated as unreleased. Arrow enters an infinite loop with 534 bytes; the issue remains open. Cloudflare's emergency WAF defaults to Log. cybersecuritynews returned 403.
strings.records.brotli-jfrog-reach.action: Inventory bundled copies and actual deployment paths. Do not consider removing br from Accept-Encoding sufficient. Republish NativeAOT. Treat ClickHouse/Arrow/libjxl as unpatched until distributed fixes are confirmed. A Log rule does not establish that blocking is complete.
strings.records.gmo-sixth-still.title: GMO report 6: the account-protection request has not been withdrawn.
strings.records.gmo-sixth-still.body: The 4 points in report 6 (full scanning, offline backups, disconnecting all sessions and changing passwords/MFA/disabling sync from another device, and optional device collection) are repeated in report 7. They cover securities, email, Google, and other services as well as FX. Infection of all connected devices has not been confirmed.
strings.records.gmo-sixth-still.action: Continue checks from another trusted device. Do not enable browser synchronization until checks are complete.
strings.records.blastmail-345.title: Blastmail: 345 contracts; resumption undetermined remains as in the 17:00 notice
strings.records.blastmail-345.body: Leakage beyond subscriber information is confirmed for 345 contracts, with 345 individually notified. The resumption time is undetermined. No content changes in this window. This does not mean 345 people, all recipients, or 345 new intrusions.
strings.records.blastmail-345.action: Check affected items through individual notifications and maintain alternative communication/delivery paths. Notification of everyone does not mean the investigation is over or resumption is authorized.
strings.records.blastmail-345.time: 17:00 JST update (in the previous window). Next update around 10 / 27 12:00
strings.records.pan-os-php.title: PAN-OS PHP: no new ETA removals in this window
strings.records.pan-os-php.body: 11.1.4-h38 / 11.1.6-h40 / 11.1.10-h36 / 11.1.13-h16 are released. Remaining ETAs (for example, 11.2.13-h4 and 10.2.13-h27 on 10/27) remain as in the table from before 05:45Z. The vendor is unaware of exploitation against its products. Retain the existing distinction that GlobalProtect portals and similar components are not impacted.
strings.records.pan-os-php.action: Close management interfaces to the internet and compare your release series against the released and ETA sections of the table. Do not use content signatures as a substitute for OS hotfixes. Do not reinterpret PAN's not aware statement as no exploitation of PHP in general.
strings.records.tailscale-1042.title: Tailscale: still 1.104.2. Minimum fixed Tailworm version undetermined
strings.records.tailscale-1042.body: The latest stable version in official bulletins and GitHub releases is 1.104.2 (eMudhra). There are no new tags or bulletins in this window. Source merges, check mode, and TS_SSH_DISABLE_FORWARDING=1 are not evidence of a distributed fix.
strings.records.tailscale-1042.action: For eMudhra distrust, use 1.104.2 or later. For SSH forwarding, Serve/Funnel, and headscale, until official fixes are issued for each item, verify alternative management paths and disable unnecessary forwarding.
strings.records.tailscale-1042.time: Latest stable 1.104.2 ( 10 / 21 ). No new tags for this window.
strings.records.php-brotli-jpcert.title: Domestic PHP / Brotli alerts: continuing guidance from 16:25 / 18:00.
strings.records.php-brotli-jpcert.body: AT-2026-0033 adds that although PoCs and attempted traffic exist, successful execution depends on version, environment, and memory layout. For CVE-2026-115560, set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 and restart all workers. Brotli AT-2026-0034 specifies fix boundaries by release series. No new Japanese alert was issued in this window.
strings.records.php-brotli-jpcert.action: Check the fix for the applicable branch and the copies actually deployed. Mitigation settings do not equal full PHP remediation.
strings.records.php-brotli-jpcert.time: JPCERT 16:25 / JVN 18:00 JST (within the previous window)
strings.records.gmo-seventh-correction.title: Reference: GMO report 7 date correction is 2 minutes after the cutoff
strings.records.gmo-seventh-correction.body: The retrieved HTML says 10/27 0:20 correction: incorrect 10/23, correct 10/25 (the date of the device investigation request). Do not backdate the correction itself as a confirmed fact at 23:10. At retrieval, the customer request date had been corrected to 10/25.
strings.records.gmo-seventh-correction.action: Check request dates on the current official page. Correction times are not intrusion or analysis completion times.
strings.records.bc-dotnet-after-cutoff.title: Reference: BleepingComputer's .NET article RSS is after the cutoff.
strings.records.bc-dotnet-after-cutoff.body: The RSS item Microsoft releases emergency .NET patches is dated 15:38 UTC. The primary sources are dotnet/announcements#494/#493 dated 10/25. Do not treat an article after the cutoff as a newly shipped release within the window.
strings.records.bc-dotnet-after-cutoff.action: Check primary guidance #494/#493 for .NET remediation. Retain NativeAOT republishing and the exclusion of Framework.
